text:
devin (eng): Heads up — we've started seeing a cluster of 413 / early-fail errors from a handful of tenants after the soft-cap rollout for embeddings. Looks correlated with mixed-dim batches. :eyes:

maria (platform PM): Oof. Which path is failing — client-side split, gateway, or router?

devin (eng): Gateway rejects with 413 before splitter kicks in. Payload example from logs: 
```json
{
  "inputs": [..large array..],
  "embedding-dim": [1536, 1024, 1536, 2048],
  "batch_bytes": 3_200_000
}
```

anya (telemetry): We only emit split_attempts when splitter runs, so these look like pre-split rejections. current metric: `embed_early_fail_count` spiking for tenant=t8-prod.

leo (runtime): That makes sense — the soft-cap logic lives in the front proxy quota check. If a single request's bytes exceed the tenant's soft threshold we fast-fail to avoid backpressure. We expected clients to pre-split, but many SDKs rely on us to split mixed-dim payloads.

sarah (devex): SDKs should be able to handle it, but we haven't shipped mixed-dim auto-split there yet. We told customers warm-up message that server would split. Sorry about the mismatch.

maria (platform PM): Action items: 1) short-term rollback of the hard pre-split fast-fail behavior (keep soft cap but let splitter attempt) 2) add console telemetry/alert so tenants see when we're auto-splitting vs failing 3) SDK patch to pre-split mixed dims. Agree?

devin (eng): Agreed. Quick patch idea: change gateway to downgrade 413 -> 202 with header `X-Embed-Split-Needed: 1` and forward to splitter, but throttle splits to avoid heavy work for large arrays.

leo (runtime): Implementation nuance — splitter needs `dim-hint` per item to decide target shard. If we synthesize work server-side we must calculate the per-item dims before any expensive unmarshalling. We can add a light-pass that reads size+metadata only.

anya (telemetry): For dashboards: suggest adding two new series: `embed_preflight_rejects` (by reason), and `embed_split_forwarded` and expose a per-tenant ratio. Also add tag `split_trigger=softcap-gateway` so we can filter.

infra-bot: canary-deploy /embed-gateway v1.4.3 -> success :white_check_mark:

maria (platform PM): Rolling rollback now or quick patch? Customers hitting failures are on Dedicated POCs — we should be careful with rollback. Maybe opt for gateway reconciliation: allow one retry/forward to splitter for requests with mixed dims, but keep soft-cap for single-dim huge requests.

devin (eng): I can spike that today. Proposed heuristic: if `embedding-dim` header is an array OR per-item meta indicates mixed dims, then convert 413 -> forward with `X-Embed-AutoSplit: 1`. Otherwise return 413.

leo (runtime): Also need a console UX change: show an estimated split count and estimated token/byte budget before request submission (like `Estimated request will generate N splits`), and surface `failed_preflight` counts in tenant dashboard. That will reduce surprise.

sarah (devex): I can draft the console copy and a small toast that warns before call when estimated splits > 1. Also add a link to SDK quick-fix.

anya (telemetry): Telemetry plan: emit `embed_preflight_reason` with values: `single_big_item`, `mixed_dims`, `unknown`; and `embed_route_hint` values: `forwarded_to_splitter`, `rejected`. We'll need a small schema bump but it's fine.

maria (platform PM): Good. Devin/Leo — schedule PRs: gateway heuristic, splitter light-pass, telemetry tags. Sarah — console copy + UX. Anya — update dashboards/alerts. Try to avoid a full rollback unless failures increase.

devin (eng): I'll open the gateway PR and add a small unit test around header synthesis. Patch will be behind `feature.embed-autosplit` flag. Posting a quick pseudo diff in case helpful:
```diff
- if (payload.bytes > tenant.softcap) return 413
+ if (payload.bytes > tenant.softcap) {
+   if (hasMixedDims(payload)) forwardToSplitter(withHeader)
+   else return 413
+ }
```

leo (runtime): For the light-pass, I'll add a `peek_dims()` function that reads per-item metadata from the first N bytes to avoid OOM. Will coordinate tests.

sarah (devex): I'll prep a short customer note and a one-liner for the status page in case this impacts more tenants.

anya (telemetry): I'll create the dashboard tiles: `preflight rejects / minute`, `forwarded splits`, `avg_splits_per_request`. I'll also add an alert if `rejected / forwarded` > 5% for any tenant over 5m.

maria (platform PM): Thanks — sync at 10:30. If anyone hits blockers ping in-thread. :thumbsup:
